message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates, 35 mph on rural non‑interstate highways, 25 mph on urban non‑interstate highways.
• Posted limits may differ; always obey posted signs. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limits page | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | TxDOT – Cell Phone Use | | **DUI / Alcohol** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission (TABC) – DUI | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red light: stop; green: go; yellow: prepare to stop.
• Stop signs: come to a complete stop.
• Yield signs: give right‑of‑way to traffic on the main road. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority.
• Pedestrians have right‑of‑way at crosswalks. | TxDOT – Right‑of‑Way | | **Lane Discipline** | • Keep to the right lane unless passing.
• Use turn lanes for left or right turns. | TxDOT – Lane Discipline | | **School Bus** | • Stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, 10 ft of a stop sign, or 15 ft of a fire hydrant.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited. | TxDOT – Parking Rules | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) | | **Insurance** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Insurance Code | | **Special Situations** | • **High‑way Advisory**: Follow the “Texas Highway Advisory” for toll roads and special lanes.
• **Winter Weather**: Use chains or winter tires if required by law. | TxDOT – Weather Alerts | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website**: Offers the most current statutes, regulations, and road conditions. - **Texas DMV**: For registration, insurance, and driver’s license information. - **Texas Attorney General**: Provides consumer protection and legal updates. - **Local County Courts**: For specific local ordinances that may supplement state law. --- #### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re set for safety. 2. **Keep a safe following distance** – especially on highways. 3. **Use headlights** from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather. 4. **Avoid distractions** – hands‑free only. 5. **Check your mirrors** before changing lanes or turning. If you need more detailed information on a specific area (e.g., DUI penalties, school bus rules, or vehicle inspection requirements), let me know and I can dive deeper!
